title: Shabe Ashoor Ayee Hai
body:
Shabe Ashoor Ayee Hai
Udasi Kaisi Chaee Hai
Faza-e- Karbala Chup Hai
Zameen Nainawa Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hawaein Kar Thi Hai Nouha
Yeh Laila Kehthi Thi Rokar
Qareeb Aja Mere Akbar
Mai Kal Hojaoungi Tanha
<<DIVIDER>>
Abhi Hain Mujmmaeen Pyase
Salamath Hai Abhi Qaime
Abhi Gazi Ka Hai Pehra
Yeh Farwa Bain Karthi Thi Ke Kal Qasim Ki Hai Shadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Dulhan Hojaegi Bewa
Nassehat Karti Thi Zainab
Hai Bacho Aaqri Ye Shab
Hai Kal Qurban Hojana
<<DIVIDER>>
Bohat Bechain Hai Bachche
Liye Sukhe Huwe Kuze
Ajab Alam Hai Gurbath Ka
Ali Asghar Bhi Hai Bechain
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh Bano Kar Rahi Hai Bain
Jhulaoun Kal Kise Jhoola
Yeh Farmate The Moula
Behan Ab Housla Rakna
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Hoga Ka Tera Bhaiya
Hai Gash Me Abid-e- Muztar
Hai Qaimoun Ka Ajab Manzar
Kare Kya Zainab-e-kubra
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh Shaida-e-ali Asghar
Rasheed Ab Hain Bohath Mauztar
Liye Aankoun Main Ek Jhoola
